note: Thresholds, the completed-test list, and the replication rule. This file stores no return, no bootstrap rate, and no verdict. completed_prior plus completed_added is the trial counter. That counter moves when a test is run, including while the verdict is PENDING-REPLICATION. Only the verdict waits for docs/backtest/replication.json. dsr_n_next is the variant count the next test's deflated Sharpe uses.

symmetry.note: Row (a) is fractional units for the strategy and the benchmark. Row (b) is whole shares of a $460 account for both, and SPY exposure uses SPYM because one SPY share costs more than $460. The verdict is row (b). Faber, when out of the market, holds cash at 0%. A BIL sleeve is information only and does not add a trial. A bug-fix re-run does not change dsr_n_next.
